title: Enterprise Key Control & Audit Observability: PRD clarifications and sign-off worksheet
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Consolidated PRD clarifications and a sign-off worksheet for Enterprise Key Control and Audit Observability scope for Private deployments. This ticket captures open questions from legal/compliance, negotiated scope reductions for early customers, acceptance criteria for SSO/SAML, operator RBAC, audit log retention/forwarding, and KMS/HSM integration with key custody options. The goal is to produce a checklist that engineering, security, and sales can sign off on before GA enrollment of private regions.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Customer SAML assertions accepted via IdP binding flows; tests executed with Okta and Azure AD in staging; documented mapping of attributes to RBAC roles.
RBAC: Admin, Operator, Auditor roles implemented via RBAC policy definitions; can be applied through console and IaC; permission matrix validated against Zero Trust baseline.

Audit logs: All request-level audit events (authn, authz, key-access, deployment changes) are emitted to customer-managed syslog/S3 with configurable retention; proof-of-delivery verified for one pilot customer.
KMS/HSM: Support for customer-managed KMS (cloud CMKs) and HSM-backed key signing for model encryption keys; keywrap/unwrapping flows documented and unit-tested.
Onboarding/runbook: Step-by-step onboarding runbook for Private customers including key escrow options, rotation guidance, and remediation steps for failed key unwraps.
Compatibility: Private deployment can operate without customer KMS (platform-managed keys) but with clear documented risk and opt-in for customer-managed keys.
Monitoring & Alerts: Alerts for failed authn/authz events, key access errors, and audit delivery failures are surfaced in Console with runbook links.
Sign-off: Security, Product, and Solutions Engineering provide explicit approval comments in this ticket and attach acceptance evidence (test logs, screenshots, and audit delivery receipts).
checklist: Design review complete: PRD clarifications captured and linked
Legal & Compliance: Reviewed retention and export controls, exceptions logged
SSO Integration: Okta + Azure AD integration tests documented
RBAC Matrix: Mapped roles and least-privilege checks completed
Audit Pipeline: Delivery to customer S3/syslog verified
KMS Integration: CMK wrap/unwrap test vectors validated
HSM: Signed key attestation test recorded (if HSM used)
Console UX: Policy & key UI flows documented and validated in staging
Runbooks: Onboarding + incident runbooks authored and linked
Customer pilot: At least one pilot completed end-to-end
